questions.improve.approve: Apply the new instruction on a trial basis
questions.improve.accept: Accept the trial result and keep the new instruction
questions.improve.cancel: Cancel the experiment and roll back any active trial
questions.improve.observe: Record an observation that may affect the trial result
questions.task.auto_accept: Allow automatic acceptance after independent review
questions.project.bind: Bind the project with the specified verification command
questions.install: Install the team in the selected mode

consequences.policy.set: The new mode governs how improvements are applied and accepted.
consequences.policy.channel: Future protected actions can be confirmed in chat.
consequences.evaluation.configure: Candidate evaluation will use the new suite and command.
consequences.improve.approve: The candidate becomes active on trial and rolls back if it fails.
consequences.improve.accept: The version stays active and the trial ends.
consequences.improve.cancel: The trial ends and an active candidate rolls back.
consequences.improve.observe: Failure triggers rollback. Success counts toward acceptance.
consequences.instruction.restore: The controller records the selected text as a new active version.
consequences.task.auto_accept: The task can be accepted after review and demo without another confirmation.
consequences.task.accept: The controller closes the task as accepted.
consequences.task.create: The controller records a task with the supplied criteria.
consequences.project.bind: The verification command applies to the specified project.
consequences.service.start: The service resumes deadline checks and rolls back expired trials.
consequences.service.stop: The service stops checking deadlines until restarted.
consequences.install: Installation starts binding three roles with the selected improvement mode.

bootstrap.read: run argv and read the JSON.
bootstrap.stop: If role read is unavailable, fails, or reports blocked, stop and
bootstrap.notify: notify the Lead (the Lead notifies the user).
bootstrap.stale: Do not work from a remembered copy.

mode.question: How should the team change its own instructions?
mode.detail: This mode only applies to instruction improvement. Network access, git push, commands outside the project, and access to secrets require permission in either mode.

autonomous.question: Allow automatic instruction changes?
warnings: Bots can apply and accept improvements without your approval.
Checks, history, and rollback stay enabled. Permissions for external actions stay the same.
